headline: Suzuki Motors test4 Forward
deck: test4's Suzuki keeps goal in Villa's 3-2 win at Spurs, a plus for test4 against 123
body:
Zion Suzuki kept goal in Villa's 3-2 win at Tottenham, and Emery singled him out afterwards. He is test4's man, and test4 is the one manager who needs a name to answer this week.

A winning goalkeeper who draws his manager's praise is the return test4 was chasing against 123. What the line reads is not yet ours to print, only that Suzuki was on the right side of a five-goal match and named for it.
